resources.string: Darkens the screen in milliseconds when someone looks from the side or over your shoulder, and stays out of the way when only you are looking.
The privacy curtain is drawn above every app.
The front camera briefly checks who is looking (320x240, on device, nothing is saved or sent).
Shows that protection is on and lets you stop it.
Needed only for "Only in chosen apps", to know which app is open.
Sleeping: screen off or not a protected app
Too dark for the camera, the tilt decides
Also darken when nobody is looking
Everywhere while the screen is on
While the phone lies still, check every %1$d s

The camera stays off while the phone is still; a move or the timer wakes it for a quick look at 320x240. The curtain comes down instantly at a head angle over 42° or a second face, and lifts softly below 32° with one face. In the dark the camera is not used; the tilt decides. Android lets touches through an overlay only up to 80% darkness.
